# Sketchfab CC BY 4.0 vehicles — attribution required

Downloaded 2026-11-05 from Sketchfab. Licence and tags checked on the Sketchfab API the same day: all CC Attribution (`license.slug == by`), no NoAI tag. GLB = Sketchfab-converted format, the lowest texture resolution offered up to 1k (vehicles) / 2k (buildings). Unity Asset Store not used. Hyundai Xcient / Hyundai Mighty (nguyenhoanglam20) were downloaded, inspected and rejected: untextured / photo-projected with a real manufacturer badge; they are not in the project.

## Content checks (2026-11-05)
- Textures inspected for real brand marks: none found on the kept models (the container truck carries the author's altered "DAV" mark; the traffic-car pack has unbranded paint; building signage is the authors' fictional Korean shop names).
- No vessel is part of any of these models. Scale is set per prefab in `Editor/ProceduralAssets.cs` (target heights for buildings; vehicle packs kept at the authored metres, van pack x0.1).
